name: Mythblock
description:
MythBlock

A OneBlock server that goes far beyond one block

Java: mythblock.me | Bedrock: mythblock.me, Port 19132

English and German speaking community, hosted in Germany

What makes MythBlock different

You start on a single block. Break it, and it turns into the next one. Over 156 phases across four regions, Overworld, Nether, End and Lumen, your one block grows into a whole island with farms, machines and a story of its own.

- Three ways to play: a relaxed Normal profile, a hardcore Ironman profile and a Season profile that competes for the monthly leaderboard. Every season everyone starts from zero.

- Minions and the Bonsai Pot: automate mining, farming and wood with upgradeable minions, and grow all 11 kinds of wood, including rare trees, in your own bonsai pot.

- Mob farms that actually work: mobs stack into one entity, spawners stack up to 16 per block and can be upgraded for speed, amount and range.

- Gear that matters: climb the gear ladders for Mining, Farming, Combat and Foraging, collect set bonuses, repair at the Forge, reforge your pieces and socket gems.

- 7 skills and 147 achievements, plus collections, a story questline and daily and weekly tasks.

- The Rift: a 32-layer roguelike dungeon where every death costs the run.

- End Dragon boss with its own arena, attack patterns and loot.

- Excavation: dig up relics and fill your island museum.

- Island events and the Lucky Block keep every session a little different.

- Player Mall: rent a plot, open your stalls and trade with everyone.

Halloween 2026 is live

Until 9 November: candy from your OneBlock, the Pumpkin King boss on the weekends, the Pumpkin Path scavenger hunt, Spooky Bags, a Halloween shop and the Halloween crate with spawners, gear and exclusive titles.

New here? We have you covered

- Myra's Academy: an interactive tutorial valley that shows you every big system in a few minutes. You can skip it any time.

- Chat translation: German and English chat is translated automatical
